item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shiritsu Sakuranbo Nyuugakkou
  • 発売日: 2013-12-31
  • スコア: 6.590000000000001/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 淫獣の檻 女子高生廃工場監禁レイプ
  • 英語名: Injuu no Ori Joshikousei Haikoujou Kankin Rape

别名

  • Japanese Schoolgirl and Abandoned Factory‛： Injuu no Ori

あらすじ

Shishikura Kasumi is a highschool girl with a boyfriend she calls Tomu-kun. She is taken to a room alone and men explain to her that her boyfriend owes them 1,000,000 yen. Since he can’t pay they offer her a proposal. If she agrees to take some ecchi lingerie pictures for them they’ll let her boyfriend go. Reluctantly Kasumi agrees.
